nodes.name: Application code
nodes.responsibility: Creates and configures a Flask application, then registers routes, blueprints, hooks, and extensions.

nodes.name: WSGI server
nodes.responsibility: Supplies the WSGI environment and start_response callback, then consumes the application response.

nodes.name: Flask WSGI application
nodes.responsibility: Owns the concrete Flask application and drives WSGI request dispatch, response finalization, teardown, and middleware wrapping.

nodes.name: Sans-IO core
nodes.responsibility: Defines application configuration, registries, setup guards, URL-map ownership, and framework behavior independent of a network server.

nodes.name: Contexts
nodes.responsibility: Creates, pushes, matches, tears down, and pops application and request state around each request or CLI operation.

nodes.name: Context globals
nodes.responsibility: Exposes current_app, request, session, g, and context proxies backed by Flask's context variables.

nodes.name: Route registry
nodes.responsibility: Provides route and hook decorators plus setup-time registration primitives used to populate application dispatch tables.

nodes.name: Blueprints
nodes.responsibility: Collects deferred blueprint routes, callbacks, templates, static resources, and CLI commands, then merges them into an application.

nodes.name: Sessions
nodes.responsibility: Loads and saves dictionary-like sessions through a pluggable interface; the default stores signed session data in cookies.

nodes.name: Templating
nodes.responsibility: Builds Flask's Jinja environment and loaders, renders templates, injects context, and emits render lifecycle signals.

nodes.name: JSON
nodes.responsibility: Provides configurable JSON dumps, loads, and response creation used by jsonify, request parsing, and automatic response conversion.

nodes.name: CLI
nodes.responsibility: Loads applications and plugins, manages app-aware commands and contexts, and launches the development server and shell commands.

nodes.name: Signals
nodes.responsibility: Defines Flask's request, application-context, template, exception, and flashing signal objects.

nodes.name: Testing
nodes.responsibility: Provides an app-aware test client, environment builder, session transactions, and Click-based CLI runner.

nodes.name: Werkzeug
nodes.responsibility: Supplies Flask's WSGI wrappers, routing maps and adapters, HTTP exceptions, response objects, test client primitives, and development server.

nodes.name: Jinja
nodes.responsibility: Provides the template environment, loaders, template compilation, and rendering engine used by Flask.

nodes.name: Click
nodes.responsibility: Provides command groups, options, invocation contexts, and CLI test-runner primitives used by Flask.

nodes.name: itsdangerous
nodes.responsibility: Signs and time-validates the serialized cookie payload used by Flask's default secure-cookie sessions.

nodes.name: Blinker
nodes.responsibility: Provides the signal namespace and dispatch mechanism behind Flask's optional signal support.

edges.label: constructs and configures Flask
edges.description: Application code imports Flask, constructs the application, and registers its routes and callbacks.

edges.label: Flask subclasses App
edges.description: flask.app.Flask extends flask.sansio.app.App and adds WSGI, request dispatch, sessions, and concrete I/O behavior.

edges.label: creates, pushes, and pops request context
binds context variables
edges.description: AppContext and RequestContext set and reset the context variables consumed by LocalProxy globals.

edges.label: register_blueprint
edges.description: App.register_blueprint delegates to Blueprint.register, which merges deferred routes and callbacks into the application.

edges.label: merges routes and hooks into app
dispatches matched endpoint
edges.description: dispatch_request reads the matched rule and view function from the request and application registries before invoking the view.

edges.label: converts JSON return values
edges.description: Flask.make_response uses the application's JSON provider for dict and list return values.

edges.label: request lifecycle signals
edges.description: full_dispatch_request, finalize_request, and teardown paths send request and application-context signals.

edges.label: Map, Rule, exceptions, and response base
creates test client and CLI runner
MapAdapter.match during request context push
edges.description: RequestContext.match_request calls self.url_adapter.match(return_rule=True), where the adapter is Werkzeug's routing adapter.
